cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Later form variant (no year in title; 'FINAL / DISSOLUTION REPORT' wording; Column B headed 'Aggregate Total') with TWO office fields - top-row 'Office' = Council and 'Office Sought' = Council, both the same. Every figure is written with a '$' and the cents as a raised superscript over a rule; transcribed with the dollar sign kept and a decimal point. Neither amendment box is checked. Signed 1-31-10 and clerk-stamped FEB 01 2010, i.e. the year-end report covering calendar 2009 - consistent with the clerk's '2009 Summary Report' label. Lines 3+4=5 and 5-6=7 both reconcile exactly.
